{{Quote|Welcome. I'm Pooja Naberrie, a Senator of the Old Republic and leader of the Naboo Resistance against the Empire.|[[Pooja Naberrie/Legends|Pooja Naberrie]], to a Rebel spacer|<ref name="SWG:SPN" />}}
The '''Naboo Resistance''' was an anti-[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] resistance movement operating on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was led by former [[Senator/Legends|senator]] [[Pooja Naberrie/Legends|Pooja Naberrie]] and was allied with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] but remained independent.

==Description==
[[File:PoojaNaberrie.png|thumb|180px|right|Pooja Naberrie, leader of the Naboo Resistance]]
The Naboo Resistance was a resistance movement that opposed the rule of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] on the world of Naboo.<ref name="SWG:SPN" /> They were relatively small in number but highly motivated.<ref name="NoP">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it was allied with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] but remained an autonomous movement. Nevertheless, the Rebel Alliance forces in the [[Chommell sector/Legends|Chommell sector]] and the Naboo Resistance worked closely and frequently shared information.<ref name="SWG:SPN" /> The rebels were heavily targeted by the Empire.<ref name="NoP" />

The Naboo Resistance on Naboo emerged from a combination of liberal-minded [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] and [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] agitators.<ref name="NoP" /> The movement was supported by a number of [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Noble/Legends|nobles]] and aristocrats with some of them, such as [[Pooja Naberrie/Legends|Pooja Naberrie]] and [[Lim Paddu]], were prominent members. Other sympathizers and members of the resistance were found among the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]], including [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rhys Dallows]] and [[Officer/Legends|Officer]] [[Turon Adala]].<ref name="SWG:SPN" /> The Naboo Resistance also counted dozens of informants and covert operatives all over Naboo.<ref name="SWG:KN">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=static|Kima Nazith|Naboo}}</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|We are assembling a conclave of Naboo aristocrats who sympathize with the Resistance.|Pooja Naberrie, to a Rebel spacer|<ref name="SWG:SPN" />}}
By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the Naboo Resistance was led by Pooja Naberrie, a former [[Senator/Legends|senator]]<ref name="SWG:SPN" /> of Naboo in the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] and niece of late [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|352|Naberrie, Pooja}}</ref> Her [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] [[Kima Nazith]] was her most trusted advisor in the Resistance.<ref name="SWG:KN" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Imperial [[High Inquisitor]] [[Mal Sikander]] suspected that Pooja Naberrie could be connected to the Naboo Resistance. This forced the former senator and Kima Nazith to go into hiding for some times in [[Dee'ja Peak/Legends|Dee'ja Peak]],<ref name="SWG:KN" /> an isolated city in the [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]] appreciated by people hostile to the Empire.<ref name="SWG:DP">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=loading|Dee'ja Peak|Naboo}}</ref> There, Nazith prevented the attempts of Sikander to localize the senator. Kima Nazith and a group of Rebel Alliance operatives assassinated a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] informant named [[Benbul Leedee]] who had been captured by the Empire before he could provide information to the Inquisitor. They then eliminated the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Hrodius Goragg]] who had been paid by Inquisitor Sikander to find the senator. Eventually, the Rebel operatives fought and killed the [[Dark side adept/Legends|Dark Side Adept]] [[Kunn Kuroosh]], a presumed [[Sith sorcerer]], who was investigating the presence of rebels in Dee'ja Peak.<ref name="SWG:KN" />

In the meantime, Naberrie did not remain inactive. She organized a conclave of Naboo nobles sympathetic to the Naboo Resistance in order to convince them to join the rebellion in a more active manner. The meeting was also supported by the Rebel Alliance that sent to Naboo the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Herosk Bal'far]], an aide to [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]] and hero of the Rebellion, as a guest of honor; as well as several Rebel operatives to help with the organization. However, the conference was compromised by the Empire even before it started due to a series of unfortunate events. The [[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] [[Gizda Ramani]] was shot down the Empire while carrying information about the meeting between the Naboo Resistance and the Rebel Alliance. The rebel Herosk Bal'far was identified and wanted by Imperial forces upon arriving on Naboo. A servant of the noble Lim Paddu named [[Jumis]] was attacked by [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] while carrying clearance codes for the meeting. RSF Officer Turon Adala, who was in charge of the security of the conference, was injured in a firefight with stormtroopers in patrol. Finally, Lim Paddu, the Naboo noble the most devoted to the Resistance, was captured by Imperial troops during a random identity check. Thankfully for Naberrie, the Rebel Alliance operatives were able to successfully rescue all these individuals alive, before the Empire could obtain any information from them. In the end, the conclave finally started, in a secret location near Dee'ja Peak. Although everything seemed to be going well, Naberrie discovered during the meeting that the servant of one of the conference participants, [[Melloc Fitzal]], was in fact a covert agent for the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]]. However, the man managed to leave the meeting undetected before the eebels realized he was a [[Spy/Legends|spy]]. The group of rebel operatives immediately went after the spy but they were too late to prevent him to join a group of [[Storm commando/Legends|storm commando]] in the Naboo wilderness. During the ensuring fight, the rebel strike team was able to kill Fitzal and his escort. Finally, the conference ended without further trouble and all participants returned from the meeting safely.<ref name="SWG:SPN" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Naboo Resistance appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:SPN" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
